linearInterpolationElection.description: Per Part 1 Section 3, 'Floating Obligations', of the 2018 ISDA CDM Equity Confirmation. Para 3.3

pricingMethodElection.description: Per Part 1 Section 5, 'Pricing', of the 2018 ISDA CDM Equity Confirmation, Para 5.1

settlementTerms.description: Per Part 1 Section 8, 'Settlement', of the 2018 ISDA CDM Equity Confirmation for Security Equity Swap

typeOfSwapElection.description: Per Part 1 Section 4, 'Dividend Obligations', of the 2018 ISDA CDM Equity Confirmation, Para 4.2 'Dividend Returns'

valuationDates.description: The parameters used to generate the 'Equity Valuation Dates' schedule, including the Effective Date and Termination Date for the Swap.

content.name: cdm/legaldocumentation/master/ExtraordinaryEvents
content.description: Where the underlying is shares, defines market events affecting the issuer of those shares that may require the terms of the transaction to be adjusted.

additionalBespokeTerms.description: Where parties may optionnaly describe any extra bespoke agreements, in regards of the standardized Extraordinary Events.

additionalDisruptionEvents.description: Per the 2002 ISDA Equity Derivatives Definitions | 2018 ISDA CDM Equity Confirmation for Security Equity Swaps

compositionOfCombinedConsideration.description: Per the 2002 ISDA Equity Derivatives Definitions:

delisting.description: Per the 2002 ISDA Equity Derivatives Definitions | 2018 ISDA CDM Equity Confirmation for Security Equity Swap:

failureToDeliver.description: If true, failure to deliver is applicable.

indexAdjustmentEvents.description: Per the 2002 ISDA Equity Derivatives Definitions: Adjustments to Indices

mergerEvents.description: Per the 2018 ISDA CDM Equity Confirmation for Security Equity Swap

nationalizationOrInsolvency.description: Per the 2002 ISDA Equity Derivatives Definitions | 2018 ISDA CDM Equity Confirmation for Security Equity Swap

tenderOfferEvents.description: Per the 2002 ISDA Equity Derivatives Definitions:

content.name: cdm/legaldocumentation/master/FxAdditionalTerms
content.description: TransactionAdditionalTerms which apply to the CurrencyPair asset class.

content.name: cdm/legaldocumentation/master/IndexAdjustmentEvents
content.description: Defines the specification of the consequences of Index Events as defined by the 2002 ISDA Equity Derivatives Definitions.

content.name: cdm/legaldocumentation/master/MasterAgreementClause
content.description: Defines clauses that make up a Master Agreement

counterparty.description: Optional counterparty role. This can be used where a clause needs to be assigned to a specific party on the agreement based upon their role i.e. Party A or Party B.

otherParty.description: Optional party. This can be required for umbrella agreements where a clause may need to be assigned to a specific party who may or may not be on the agreement.

variant.description: Allows multiple variants to be defined for a clause. This needs to be an array as some clauses can specify different variants for different parties. At least one variant must be specified for a clause.

content.name: cdm/legaldocumentation/master/MasterAgreementClauseVariant
content.description: Sets the details for a specific variant associated to a clause in a Master Agreement

counterparty.description: Optional counterparty role. This can be used where a clause needs to assign a different variant to the different parties on the agreement based upon their role i.e. Party A or Party B.

identifier.description: Unique identifier for this variant

otherParty.description: Optional party. This can be used where a clause needs to assign different variants to different parties who may or may not be on the agreement.

variableSet.description: For some variants of some clauses additional details are required to work out what has been elected. This array can be used to define the name and value of these variables. Please refer to the agreement documentation for more details of the variables that are available for any clause.

content.name: cdm/legaldocumentation/master/MasterAgreementSchedule
content.description: The set of elections which specify a Master Agreement.

clause.description: Clauses that have had elections made against them in this Master Agreement. There must be at least one clause defined in the agreement.

content.name: cdm/legaldocumentation/master/MasterAgreementTypeEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify the type of the master agreement governing the transaction.

content.name: cdm/legaldocumentation/master/MasterAgreementVariableSet
content.description: Defines a type where additional variables associated to clauses and their variants can be described.

val.description: The value for this variable

variableSet.description: For some variants a table of variables is required. To support this use case we need to be able to specify variables within variables. Including a variable set here gives us infinite nesting opportunities - realistically we are only ever expecting that a table would need to be defined for any particular clause, so we would expect two levels of nesting as a maximum i.e. variableSet->variableSet->name/value.

content.name: cdm/legaldocumentation/master/MasterConfirmationAnnexTypeEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify the type of annex to be used with master confirmation agreement governing the transaction.

content.name: cdm/legaldocumentation/master/MasterConfirmationBase
content.description: Legal agreement specification for General Terms and Elections that are applicable across multiple confirmations and are referenced by these confirmations.

content.name: cdm/legaldocumentation/master/MasterConfirmationTypeEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify the type of master confirmation agreement governing the transaction. While FpML positions the date a prefix, the CDM positions it as the suffix to handle grammar type constraints.

content.name: cdm/legaldocumentation/master/NationalizationOrInsolvencyOrDelistingEventEnum
content.description: Defines the consequences of nationalization, insolvency and delisting events relating to the underlying.

content.name: cdm/legaldocumentation/master/TransactionAdditionalTerms
content.description: Additional specification for the extraordinary events that may affect a trade and the related contractual rights and obligation of the parties when this happens. Such terms are typically required to extend the economics terms, for the purpose of producing the final legal contractual form of the Transaction.

content.name: cdm/legaldocumentation/master/UnderlierSubstitutionProvision
content.description: Where parties describe any substitution terms.

disputingParty.description: Where the party who is not granted with the substitution role at least has a right to dispute the determination given by the counterparty with such role. As an example, a given PartyA is the unique Counterparty with the Role of WhoMaySubstitute, yet PartyB could be Disputing Party in regard of such Role.

substitutionBeSpokeTerms.description: Where parties describe any substitution terms e.g. for instance the election criteria for an Asset to be eligible as the Substitute Asset to the prior Affected Asset in terms of sector of activity, currency, market capitalisation, liquidity, volatility, or any additional features that parties would agree to take into considerations, etc.

substitutionTriggerEvents.description: Where the parties may optionnally explictly specify the list of Events to be considered as a trigger for a Substitution.

whoMaySubstitute.description: Designates which Counterparty to the transaction who has the right to trigger a substitution or to provide related determination e.g. for instance to qualify the effectiveness of an Event which may be a trigger for substitution, determine the replacement Share to substitute, etc. ; cardinality of this object is 2, in case parties jointly have this role.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/Basket
content.description: Defines a custom basket by referencing an identifier and its constituents.

basketConstituent.description: Identifies the constituents of the basket

exchange.description: If the Asset is listed, defines the public exchange of the listing.

identifier.description: Asset Identifiers are used to uniquely identify an Asset, using a specified Asset Identifier Type.

isExchangeListed.description: Defines whether the Asset is listed on a public exchange.

relatedExchange.description: Provides the related Exchanges, if applicable.

taxonomy.description: Defines the taxonomy of an object by combining a taxonomy source (i.e. the rules to classify the object) and a value (i.e. the output of those rules on the object.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/BasketConstituent
content.description: Identifies the constituents of the basket

Asset.description: The object to be observed is an Asset, ie something that can be owned and transferred in the financial markets.

Basket.description: The object to be observed is a Basket, ie a collection of Observables with an identifier and optional weightings.

finalValuationPrice.description: Specifies a final price schedule to be associated to an individual underlier that is a basket constituent. The multiple cardinality is aligned to the one of the PriceQuantity->price that this price is referencing.

Index.description: The object to be observed is an Index, ie an observable computed on the prices, rates or valuations of a number of assets.

initialValuationPrice.description: Specifies an initial price schedule to be associated to an individual underlier that is a basket constituent. The multiple cardinality is aligned to the one of the PriceQuantity->price that this price is referencing.

interimValuationPrice.description: Specifies an interim price schedule to be associated to an individual underlier that is a basket constituent. The multiple cardinality is aligned to the one of the PriceQuantity->price that this price is referencing.

quantity.description: Specifies a quantity schedule to be associated to an individual underlier that is a basket constituent. The multiple cardinality is aligned to the one of the PriceQuantity->quantity that this quantity is referencing.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/CalculationAgent
content.description: A class defining the ISDA calculation agent responsible for performing duties as defined in the applicable product definitions.

calculationAgentBusinessCenter.description: The city in which the office through which ISDA Calculation Agent is acting for purposes of the transaction is located The short-form confirm for a trade that is executed under a Sovereign or Asia Pacific Master Confirmation Agreement ( MCA ), does not need to specify the Calculation Agent. However, the confirm does need to specify the Calculation Agent City. This is due to the fact that the MCA sets the value for Calculation Agent but does not set the value for Calculation Agent City.

calculationAgentParty.description: Specifies the party which is the ISDA Calculation Agent for the trade. If more than one party is referenced then the parties are assumed to be co-calculation agents, i.e. they have joint responsibility.

calculationAgentPartyEnum.description: Specifies the ISDA calculation agent responsible for performing duties as defined in the applicable product definitions. For example, the Calculation Agent may be defined as being the Non-exercising Party.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/CashCollateralValuationMethod
content.description: This type is a generic structure that can represent the parameters of several mid-market valuation and replacement value methods described in the 2021 ISDA Definitions.

agreedDiscountRate.description: This may be used to indicate the discount rate to be used for cash collateral for cash settlement purposes.

applicableCsa.description: This may be used to specify what type of CSA (credit support annex/agreement) is to be used for cash settlement purposes.

cashCollateralCurrency.description: This may be used to indicate the currency of cash collateral for cash settlement purposes.

cashCollateralInterestRate.description: This may be used to indicate the interest rate to be used for cash collateral for cash settlement purposes.

prescribedDocumentationAdjustment.description: This may be used to indicate that 'prescribed documentation adjustment' is applicable.

protectedParty.description: This may be used to specify which party is protected (e.g. under Replacement Value cash settlement methods).

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/CashPrice
content.description: Specifies the nature of a cash price either as a fee type, cash price type, or premium expression.

cashPriceType.description: Specifies the type of Cash Price.

feeType.description: Specifies the event type associated with a fee.

premiumExpression.description: Specifies a premium when expressed in a way other than an amount, and any required forward starting price definition.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/CashPriceTypeEnum
content.description: Provides a list of possible types of cash prices, applicable when PriceTypeEnum is itself of type CashPrice.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/CommodityReferencePriceEnum
content.description: The enumeration values to specify the Commodity Reference Prices specified in the Annex to the 2005 ISDA Commodity Definitions.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/CreditIndex
content.description: Specification of an index based on credit risk, typically composed using corporate debt instruments in a region or industry sector, e.g. the iTraxx indices.

assetClass.description: The Asset Class of the Index.

exchange.description: If the Asset is listed, defines the public exchange of the listing.

identifier.description: Asset Identifiers are used to uniquely identify an Asset, using a specified Asset Identifier Type.

indexAnnexDate.description: A CDS index series annex date.

indexAnnexSource.description: A CDS index series annex source.

indexAnnexVersion.description: A CDS index series version identifier, e.g. 1, 2, 3 etc.

indexFactor.description: Index Factor is the index version factor or percent, expressed as an absolute decimal value between 0 and 1, that multiplied by the original notional amount yields the notional amount covered by the seller of protection.

indexSeries.description: A CDS index series identifier, e.g. 1, 2, 3 etc.

isExchangeListed.description: Defines whether the Asset is listed on a public exchange.

provider.description: The organisation that creates or maintains the Index.

relatedExchange.description: Provides the related Exchanges, if applicable.

seniority.description: Seniority of debt instruments comprising the index.

settledEntityMatrix.description: Used to specify the Relevant Settled Entity Matrix when there are settled entities at the time of the trade.

taxonomy.description: Defines the taxonomy of an object by combining a taxonomy source (i.e. the rules to classify the object) and a value (i.e. the output of those rules on the object.

tranche.description: This element contains CDS tranche terms.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/CreditNotation
content.description: Represents a class to specify the credit notation as the combination of agency, notation, scale and debt type qualifications.

agency.description: Specifies The credit agency to which the other variables (notation, scale, debt type) refer to.

creditWatch.description: Indicates the potential direction of a short-term or long-term rating. It focuses on identifiable events and short-term trends that cause ratings to be placed under special surveillance.

debt.description: Specifies the credit rating debt type (e.g. long term, high yield, deposits, ...) associated with the credit rating notation and scale.

notation.description: Specifies The credit rating notation. As it varies among credit rating agencies, FpML doesn't specify a default scheme.

outlook.description: Assesses the potential direction of a long-term credit rating over the intermediate term, which is generally up to two years for investment grade and generally up to one year for speculative grade.

scale.description: Specifies the credit rating scale, with a typical distinction between short term, long term. FpML doesn't specify a default scheme, which is hence not specified as an enumeration as part of the CDM.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/CreditNotationBoundaryEnum
content.description: Identifies an agency rating as a simple scale boundary of minimum or maximum.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/CreditNotationMismatchResolutionEnum
content.description: Represents an enumeration list to identify the characteristics of the rating if there are several agency issue ratings but not equivalent, reference will be made to label characteristics of the rating such as the lowest/highest available.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/CreditNotations
content.description: Represents the credit rating notation higher level construct, which provides the ability to specify multiple rating notations.

creditNotation.description: Specifies only one credit notation is determined.

creditNotations.description: Specifies if several credit notations exist, alongside an 'any' or 'all' or all condition.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/CreditRatingAgencyEnum
content.description: Represents the enumerated values to specify the rating agencies.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/CreditRatingCreditWatchEnum
content.description: Represents the enumerated values to specify the credit watch rating.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/CreditRatingDebt
content.description: Specifies the credit rating debt type(s) associated with the credit rating notation and scale. When several debt types are specified, they must be qualified through an 'any' or 'all'.

debtType.description: Specifies when there is only one debt type. FpML doesn't specify values in relation to the associated scheme, which is hence not specified as an enumeration as part of the CDM.

debtTypes.description: Specifies if there are several debt types, alongside an 'any' or 'all' or all condition. As an example, Baa1 rating is required for any long term debt and deposit.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/CreditRatingOutlookEnum
content.description: Represents the enumerated values to specify the credit rating outlook.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/CsaTypeEnum
content.description: How is the Creadit Support Annex defined for this transaction as defined in the 2021 ISDA Definitions, section 18.2.1

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/DividendApplicability
content.description: The parameters which define whether dividends are applicable

additionalDividends.description: If present and true, then additional dividends are applicable.

allDividends.description: Represents the European Master Confirmation value of 'All Dividends' which, when applicable, signifies that, for a given Ex-Date, the daily observed Share Price for that day is adjusted (reduced) by the cash dividend and/or the cash value of any non cash dividend per Share (including Extraordinary Dividends) declared by the Issuer. All Dividends in accordance with the ISDA 2002 Equity Derivatives Definitions.

optionsExchangeDividends.description: If present and true, then options exchange dividends are applicable.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/EquityIndex
content.description: Specification of an index based on equity securities, e.g. the S&P 500..

assetClass.description: The Asset Class of the Index.

exchange.description: If the Asset is listed, defines the public exchange of the listing.

identifier.description: Asset Identifiers are used to uniquely identify an Asset, using a specified Asset Identifier Type.

isExchangeListed.description: Defines whether the Asset is listed on a public exchange.

provider.description: The organisation that creates or maintains the Index.

relatedExchange.description: Provides the related Exchanges, if applicable.

taxonomy.description: Defines the taxonomy of an object by combining a taxonomy source (i.e. the rules to classify the object) and a value (i.e. the output of those rules on the object.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/FallbackReferencePrice
content.description: The method, prioritised by the order it is listed in this element, to get a replacement rate for the disrupted settlement rate option.

calculationAgentDetermination.description: The calculation agent will decide the rate.

fallBackSettlementRateOption.description: This settlement rate option will be used in its place.

fallbackSurveyValuationPostponement.description: Request rate quotes from the market. This element is set as type Empty in FpML. When present, the FpML synonym is mapped to a value True in the CDM.

valuationPostponement.description: Specifies how long to wait to get a quote from a settlement rate option upon a price source disruption.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/FeeTypeEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify an event that has given rise to a fee.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/FloatingRateIndex
content.description: Specification of an interest rate index which can change over time, e.g. the SONIA (Sterling Overnight Index Average) in the UK.

assetClass.description: The Asset Class of the Index.

exchange.description: If the Asset is listed, defines the public exchange of the listing.

floatingRateIndex.description: The reference index that is used to specify the floating interest rate.

identifier.description: Asset Identifiers are used to uniquely identify an Asset, using a specified Asset Identifier Type.

indexTenor.description: The ISDA Designated Maturity, i.e. the floating rate tenor.

isExchangeListed.description: Defines whether the Asset is listed on a public exchange.

provider.description: The organisation that creates or maintains the Index.

relatedExchange.description: Provides the related Exchanges, if applicable.

taxonomy.description: Defines the taxonomy of an object by combining a taxonomy source (i.e. the rules to classify the object) and a value (i.e. the output of those rules on the object.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/ForeignExchangeRateIndex
content.description: Specification of a rate based on the exchange of a pair of cash assets in specific currencies, e.g. USD versus GBP.

assetClass.description: The Asset Class of the Index.

exchange.description: If the Asset is listed, defines the public exchange of the listing.

identifier.description: Asset Identifiers are used to uniquely identify an Asset, using a specified Asset Identifier Type.

isExchangeListed.description: Defines whether the Asset is listed on a public exchange.

primaryFxSpotRateSource.description: Specifies the primary source from which a rate should be observed.

provider.description: The organisation that creates or maintains the Index.

quotedCurrencyPair.description: Describes the composition of a rate that has been quoted or is to be quoted.

relatedExchange.description: Provides the related Exchanges, if applicable.

secondaryFxSpotRateSource.description: Specifies an alternative, or secondary, source from which a rate should be observed.

taxonomy.description: Defines the taxonomy of an object by combining a taxonomy source (i.e. the rules to classify the object) and a value (i.e. the output of those rules on the object.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/FxInformationSource
content.description: Information source specific to Foreign Exchange products.

fixingTime.description: The time that the fixing will be taken along with a business center to define the time zone.

sourcePage.description: A specific page for the source for obtaining a market data point. In FpML, this is specified as a scheme, rateSourcePageScheme, for which no coding Scheme or URI is specified.

sourcePageHeading.description: The heading for the source on a given source page.

sourceProvider.description: An information source for obtaining a market data point. For example Bloomberg, Reuters, Telerate, etc.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/FxRate
content.description: A class describing the rate of a currency conversion: pair of currency, quotation mode and exchange rate.

quotedCurrencyPair.description: Defines the two currencies for an FX trade and the quotation relationship between the two currencies.

rate.description: The rate of exchange between the two currencies of the leg of a deal. Must be specified with a quote basis.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/FxRateSourceFixing
content.description: Describes a rate source to be fixed and the date the fixing occurs

fixingDate.description: The date on which the fixing is scheduled to occur.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/FxSettlementRateSource
content.description: The source of the Foreign Exchange settlement rate.

nonstandardSettlementRate.description: Indicates that a non-standard rate source will be used for the fixing.

settlementRateOption.description: Indicates that an officially defined rate settlement rate option will be the used for the fixing.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/FxSpotRateSource
content.description: A class defining the rate source and fixing time for an FX rate.

primarySource.description: The primary source for where the rate observation will occur. Will typically be either a page or a reference bank published rate.

secondarySource.description: An alternative, or secondary, source for where the rate observation will occur. Will typically be either a page or a reference bank published rate.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/Index
content.description: An Index is an Observable which is computed based on the prices, rates or valuations of a number of assets that are tracked in a standardized way.  Examples include equity market indices as well as indices on interest rates, inflation and credit instruments.

CreditIndex.description: An index based on credit risk, typically composed using corporate debt instruments in a region or industry sector, e.g. the iTraxx indices.

EquityIndex.description: An index based on equity securities, e.g. the S&P 500.

ForeignExchangeRateIndex.description: A rate based on the exchange of a pair of cash assets in specific currencies, e.g. USD versus GBP.

InterestRateIndex.description: An index based in interest rates or inflation rates in a certain market.

OtherIndex.description: An index created by a market participant which doesn't align with the other index types.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/IndexBase
content.description: Identifies an index by referencing an identifier.

assetClass.description: The Asset Class of the Index.

exchange.description: If the Asset is listed, defines the public exchange of the listing.

identifier.description: Asset Identifiers are used to uniquely identify an Asset, using a specified Asset Identifier Type.

isExchangeListed.description: Defines whether the Asset is listed on a public exchange.

provider.description: The organisation that creates or maintains the Index.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/InflationIndex
content.description: Specification of an index that measures inflation in a specific market, e.g. the US Consumer Price Index.

assetClass.description: The Asset Class of the Index.

exchange.description: If the Asset is listed, defines the public exchange of the listing.

identifier.description: Asset Identifiers are used to uniquely identify an Asset, using a specified Asset Identifier Type.

indexTenor.description: The ISDA Designated Maturity, i.e. the floating rate tenor.

inflationRateIndex.description: The reference index that is used to specify the inflation interest rate.

isExchangeListed.description: Defines whether the Asset is listed on a public exchange.

provider.description: The organisation that creates or maintains the Index.

relatedExchange.description: Provides the related Exchanges, if applicable.

taxonomy.description: Defines the taxonomy of an object by combining a taxonomy source (i.e. the rules to classify the object) and a value (i.e. the output of those rules on the object.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/InformationProviderEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify the list of information providers.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/InformationSource
content.description: A class defining the source for a piece of information (e.g. a rate fix or an FX fixing). The attribute names have been adjusted from FpML to address the fact that the information is not limited to rates.

sourcePage.description: A specific page for the source for obtaining a market data point. In FpML, this is specified as a scheme, rateSourcePageScheme, for which no coding Scheme or URI is specified.

sourcePageHeading.description: The heading for the source on a given source page.

sourceProvider.description: An information source for obtaining a market data point. For example Bloomberg, Reuters, Telerate, etc.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/InterestRateIndex
content.description: An index based in interest rates or inflation rates in a certain market.

FloatingRateIndex.description: An interest rate index which can change over time, e.g. the SONIA (Sterling Overnight Index Average) in the UK.

InflationIndex.description: An index that measures inflation in a specific market, e.g. the US Consumer Price Index.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/InterpolationMethodEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify the interpolation method, e.g. linear.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/MakeWholeAmount
content.description: A class to specify the amount to be paid by the buyer of the option if the option is exercised prior to the Early Call Date (typically applicable to the convertible bond options).

earlyCallDate.description: Date prior to which the option buyer will have to pay a Make Whole Amount to the option seller if he/she exercises the option.

indexTenor.description: The ISDA Designated Maturity, i.e. the tenor of the floating rate.

interpolationMethod.description: The type of interpolation method that the calculation agent reserves the right to use.

spread.description: Spread in basis points over the floating rate index.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/Money
content.description: Defines a monetary amount in a specified currency.

datedValue.description: A schedule of step date and value pairs. On each step date the associated step value becomes effective. The step dates are used to order the steps by ascending order. This attribute is optional so the data type may be used to define a schedule with a single value.

frequency.description: Defines the frequency to be used when defining a quantity. For example a quantity may be specified as a number of barrels of oil per day, which needs multiplying by the number of days in the relevant period to get the total quantity as a number of barrels.

multiplier.description: Defines an optional number that the quantity should be multiplied by to derive a total quantity. This number is associated to a unit. For example in the case of the Coal (API2) CIF ARA (ARGUS-McCloskey) Futures Contract on the CME, where the unit would be contracts, the multiplier value would 1,000 and the mulitiplier unit would be 1,000 MT (Metric Tons).

unit.description: Qualifies the unit by which the amount is measured. Optional because a measure may be unit-less (e.g. when representing a ratio between amounts in the same unit).

val.description: Specifies the value of the measure as a number. Optional because in a measure vector or schedule, this single value may be omitted.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/MultipleCreditNotations
content.description: Represetns a class to specify multiple credit notations alongside a conditional 'any' or 'all' qualifier.

condition.description: An enumerated element, to qualify whether All or Any credit notation applies.

creditNotation.description: At least two credit notations much be specified.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/MultipleDebtTypes
content.description: Represents a class to specify multiple credit debt types alongside a conditional 'any' or 'all' qualifier.

condition.description: An enumerated attribute, to qualify whether All or Any debt type applies.

debtType.description: The type of debt, e.g. long term debt, deposit, ... FpML doesn't specific a scheme value, hence no enumeration is specified as part of the CDM. At least two debt types much be specified.

businessDays.description: A number of business days. Its precise meaning is dependant on the context in which this element is used. ISDA 2003 Term: Business Day.

businessDaysThereafter.description: The number of business days between successive valuation dates when multiple valuation dates are applicable for cash settlement. ISDA 2003 Term: Business Days thereafter.

numberValuationDates.description: Where multiple valuation dates are specified as being applicable for cash settlement, this element specifies (a) the number of applicable valuation dates, and (b) the number of business days after satisfaction of all conditions to settlement when the first such valuation date occurs, and (c) the number of business days thereafter of each successive valuation date. ISDA 2003 Term: Multiple Valuation Dates.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/Observable
content.description: Specifies the object to be observed for a price, it could be an asset or a reference.

Asset.description: The object to be observed is an Asset, ie something that can be owned and transferred in the financial markets.

Basket.description: The object to be observed is a Basket, ie a collection of Observables with an identifier and optional weightings.

Index.description: The object to be observed is an Index, ie an observable computed on the prices, rates or valuations of a number of assets.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/OtherIndex
content.description: Specification of a user-defined index that does not meet the criteria of other Index data types.

assetClass.description: The Asset Class of the Index.

exchange.description: If the Asset is listed, defines the public exchange of the listing.

identifier.description: Asset Identifiers are used to uniquely identify an Asset, using a specified Asset Identifier Type.

isExchangeListed.description: Defines whether the Asset is listed on a public exchange.

provider.description: The organisation that creates or maintains the Index.

relatedExchange.description: Provides the related Exchanges, if applicable.

taxonomy.description: Defines the taxonomy of an object by combining a taxonomy source (i.e. the rules to classify the object) and a value (i.e. the output of those rules on the object.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/PartyDeterminationEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify how a calculation agent will be determined.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/PerformanceValuationDates
content.description: Defines how and when a performance type option or performance type swap is to be valued.

determinationMethod.description: Specifies the method according to which an amount or a date is determined.

valuationDate.description: 2018 ISDA CDM Equity Confirmation for Security Equity Swap: Pricing Date

valuationDates.description: 2018 ISDA CDM Equity Confirmation for Security Equity Swap: Pricing Date

valuationTime.description: The specific time of day at which the calculation agent values the underlying. The SpecificTime is the only case when the valuationTime (time + business center location  e.g. 10:00:00 USNY) should be provided. You should be able to provide just the valuationTime without valuationTimeType, which infer that this is a specific time.

valuationTimeType.description: The time of day at which the calculation agent values the underlying, for example the official closing time of the exchange.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/PremiumExpression
content.description: This class corresponds to the FpML Premium.model group for representing the option premium when expressed in a way other than an amount.

percentageOfNotional.description: The amount of premium to be paid expressed as a percentage of the notional value of the transaction. A percentage of 5% would be expressed as 0.05.

pricePerOption.description: The amount of premium to be paid expressed as a function of the number of options.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/PremiumTypeEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify the premium type for forward start options.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/Price
content.description: Specifies a price as a single value to be associated to a financial product. This data type extends PriceSchedule and requires that only the amount value exists.

arithmeticOperator.description: (Optionally) When the price is to be understood as an operator to apply to an observable, i.e. a spread, multiplier or min/max.

cashPrice.description: (Optionally when the price type is cash) Additional attributes that further define a cash price, e.g. what type of fee it is.

composite.description: (Optionally) Specifies the underlying price components if the price can be expressed as a composite: e.g. dirty price = clean price + accrued.

datedValue.description: A schedule of step date and value pairs. On each step date the associated step value becomes effective. The step dates are used to order the steps by ascending order. This attribute is optional so the data type may be used to define a schedule with a single value.

perUnitOf.description: Provides an attribute to define the unit of the thing being priced. For example, {amount, unitOfAmount, PerUnitOfAmount} = [10, EUR, Shares] = (10.00 EUR/SHARE) * (300,000 SHARES) = EUR 3,000,000.00 (Shares cancel out in the calculation).

priceExpression.description: (Optionally) Specifies whether the price is expressed in absolute or percentage terms.

priceType.description: Specifies the price type as an enumeration: interest rate, exchange rate, asset price etc. This attribute is mandatory so that prices can always be clasiffied according to their type. The price type implies some constraints on the price's units.

unit.description: Qualifies the unit by which the amount is measured. Optional because a measure may be unit-less (e.g. when representing a ratio between amounts in the same unit).

val.description: Specifies the value of the measure as a number. Optional because in a measure vector or schedule, this single value may be omitted.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/PriceComposite
content.description: Defines the inputs required to calculate a price as a simple composite of 2 other values. The inputs consist of 2 numbers and a simple arithmetic operator. This generic data type applies to a variety of use cases where a price is obtained by simple composition, e.g. dirty = clean + accrued (Bond), forward rate = spot rate + forward point (FX) etc.

arithmeticOperator.description: Specifies the arithmetic operator via an enumeration.

baseValue.description: The 1st value in the arithmetic operation, which may be non-commutative in some cases: Subtract, Divide). This 1st operand is called 'baseValue' as it refers to the price anchor in the arithmetic operation: e.g. the clean price (Bond) or the spot rate (FX).

operand.description: The 2nd value in the arithmetic operation, which may be non-commutative in some cases: Subtract, Divide). The 2nd operand is called 'operand' to distinguish it from the 1st one which is the price anchor.

operandType.description: Optionally qualifies the type of operand: e.g. accrued or forward point.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/PriceExpressionEnum
content.description: Enumerated values to specify whether the price is expressed in absolute or relative terms.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/PriceQuantity
content.description: Defines a settlement as an exchange between two parties of a specified quantity of an asset (the quantity) against a specified quantity of another asset (the price). The settlement is optional and can be either cash or physical. The quantity can additionally be specified in terms of one or more currency amounts. In the case of non-cash products, the settlement of the price/quantity would not be specified here and instead would be delegated to the product mechanics, as parameterised by the price/quantity values.

effectiveDate.description: Specifies the date at which the price and quantity become effective. This day may be subject to adjustment in accordance with a business day convention, or could be specified as relative to a trade date, for instance. Optional cardinality, as the effective date is usually specified in the product definition, so it may only need to be specified as part of the PriceQuantity in an increase/decrease scenario for an existing trade.

observable.description: Specifies the object to be observed for a price, it could be an asset or an index. The cardinality is optional as some quantity / price cases have no observable (e.g. a fixed rate in a given currency).

price.description: Specifies a price to be used for trade amounts and other purposes.

quantity.description: Specifies a quantity to be associated with an event, for example a trade amount.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/PriceSchedule
content.description: Specifies the price of a financial instrument in a trade as a schedule of measures. A price generically expresses the value of an exchange as a ratio: it measures the amount of one thing needed to be exchanged for 1 unit of another thing (e.g. cash in a specific currency in exchange for a bond or share). This generic representation can be used to support any type of financial price beyond just cash price: e.g. an interest rate, a foreign exchange rate, etc. This data type is generically based on a schedule and can also be used to represent a price as a single value.

arithmeticOperator.description: (Optionally) When the price is to be understood as an operator to apply to an observable, i.e. a spread, multiplier or min/max.

cashPrice.description: (Optionally when the price type is cash) Additional attributes that further define a cash price, e.g. what type of fee it is.

composite.description: (Optionally) Specifies the underlying price components if the price can be expressed as a composite: e.g. dirty price = clean price + accrued.

datedValue.description: A schedule of step date and value pairs. On each step date the associated step value becomes effective. The step dates are used to order the steps by ascending order. This attribute is optional so the data type may be used to define a schedule with a single value.

perUnitOf.description: Provides an attribute to define the unit of the thing being priced. For example, {amount, unitOfAmount, PerUnitOfAmount} = [10, EUR, Shares] = (10.00 EUR/SHARE) * (300,000 SHARES) = EUR 3,000,000.00 (Shares cancel out in the calculation).

priceExpression.description: (Optionally) Specifies whether the price is expressed in absolute or percentage terms.

priceType.description: Specifies the price type as an enumeration: interest rate, exchange rate, asset price etc. This attribute is mandatory so that prices can always be clasiffied according to their type. The price type implies some constraints on the price's units.

unit.description: Qualifies the unit by which the amount is measured. Optional because a measure may be unit-less (e.g. when representing a ratio between amounts in the same unit).

val.description: Specifies the value of the measure as a number. Optional because in a measure vector or schedule, this single value may be omitted.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/PriceSourceDisruption
content.description: A data defining:  the parameters used to get a price quote to replace the settlement rate option that is disrupted.

fallbackReferencePrice.description: The method, prioritised by the order it is listed in this element, to get a replacement rate for the disrupted settlement rate option.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/PriceTypeEnum
content.description: Provides enumerated values for types of prices in the Price data type in order to explain how to interpret the amount and use it in calculations.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/QuotationRateTypeEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify the type of quotation rate to be obtained from each cash settlement reference bank.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/QuotationSideEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify the side from which perspective a value is quoted.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/QuotationStyleEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify the actual quotation style (e.g. PointsUpFront, TradedSpread) used to quote a credit default swap fee leg.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/QuoteBasisEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify how an exchange rate is quoted.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/QuotedCurrencyPair
content.description: A class that describes the composition of a rate that has been quoted or is to be quoted. This includes the two currencies and the quotation relationship between the two currencies and is used as a building block throughout the FX specification.

currency1.description: The first currency specified when a pair of currencies is to be evaluated.

currency2.description: The second currency specified when a pair of currencies is to be evaluated.

quoteBasis.description: The method by which the exchange rate is quoted.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/RateObservation
content.description: A class defining parameters associated with an individual observation or fixing. This class forms part of the cashflow representation of a stream.

adjustedFixingDate.description: The adjusted fixing date, i.e. the actual date the rate is observed. The date should already be adjusted for any applicable business day convention.

forecastRate.description: The value representing the forecast rate used to calculate the forecast future value of the accrual period.A value of 1% should be represented as 0.01.

observationWeight.description: The number of days weighting to be associated with the rate observation, i.e. the number of days such rate is in effect. This is applicable in the case of a weighted average method of calculation where more than one reset date is established for a single calculation period.

observedRate.description: The actual observed rate before any required rate treatment is applied, e.g. before converting a rate quoted on a discount basis to an equivalent yield. An observed rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

rateReference.description: A pointer style reference to a floating rate component defined as part of a stub calculation period amount component. It is only required when it is necessary to distinguish two rate observations for the same fixing date which could occur when linear interpolation of two different rates occurs for a stub calculation period.

treatedForecastRate.description: The value representing the forecast rate after applying rate treatment rules. A value of 1% should be represented as 0.01.

treatedRate.description: The observed rate after any required rate treatment is applied. A treated rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/ReferenceSwapCurve
content.description: A complex type used to specify the option and convertible bond option strike when expressed in reference to a swap curve.

makeWholeAmount.description: Amount to be paid by the buyer of the option if the option is exercised prior to the Early Call Date. (The market practice in the convertible bond option space being that the buyer should be penalised if he/she exercises the option early on.)

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/SettlementRateOption
content.description: Defines the settlement rate option to use for fixing in case of cash settlement. Currently only applicable to foreign exchange fixing in case of cross-currency settlement.

priceSourceDisruption.description: An attribute defining the parameters to get a new quote when a settlement rate option is disrupted.

settlementRateOption.description: The rate source for the conversion to the settlement currency. This source is specified through a scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/SettlementRateOptionEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify the settlement rate options as specified in the Annex A to the 1998 FX and Currency Options Definitions.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/SingleValuationDate
content.description: A class to specify the number of business days after satisfaction of all conditions to settlement.

businessDays.description: A number of business days. Its precise meaning is dependant on the context in which this element is used. ISDA 2003 Term: Business Day.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/SwapCurveValuation
content.description: A class to specify a valuation swap curve, which is used as part of the strike construct for the bond and convertible bond options.

indexTenor.description: The ISDA Designated Maturity, i.e. the tenor of the floating rate.

spread.description: Spread in basis points over the floating rate index.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/TransactedPrice
content.description: A class to represent the transacted price attributes that are positioned as part of the FpML FeeLeg.

initialPoints.description: An optional element that contains the up-front points expressed as a percentage of the notional. An initialPoints value of 5% would be represented as 0.05. The initialPoints element is an alternative to marketFixedRate in quoting the traded level of a trade. When initialPoints is used, the traded level is the sum of fixedRate and initialPoints. The initialPoints is one of the items that are factored into the initialPayment calculation and is payable by the Buyer to the Seller. Note that initialPoints and marketFixedRate may both be present in the same document when both implied values are desired.

marketFixedRate.description: An optional element that only has meaning in a credit index trade. This element contains the credit spread ('fair value') at which the trade was executed. Unlike the fixedRate of an index, the marketFixedRate varies over the life of the index depending on market conditions. The marketFixedRate is the price of the index as quoted by trading desks.

marketPrice.description: An optional element that only has meaning in a credit index trade. This element contains the price at which the trade was executed and is used instead of marketFixedRate on credit trades on certain indicies which are quoted using a price rather than a spread.

quotationStyle.description: An optional element that contains the up-front points expressed as a percentage of the notional. An initialPoints value of 5% would be represented as 0.05. The initialPoints element is an alternative to marketFixedRate in quoting the traded level of a trade. When initialPoints is used, the traded level is the sum of fixedRate and initialPoints. The initialPoints is one of the items that are factored into the initialPayment calculation and is payable by the Buyer to the Seller. Note that initialPoints and marketFixedRate may both be present in the same document when both implied values are desired.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/ValuationDates
content.description: Defines how and when a performance type option or performance type swap is to be valued, including initial, interim and final valuation dates.

finalValuationDate.description: Specifies the final valuation dates of the underlyer.

initialValuationDate.description: Specifies the initial valuation dates of the underlyer.

interimValuationDate.description: Specifies the interim valuation dates of the underlyer.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/ValuationMethod
content.description: Specifies the parameters required to obtain a valuation, including the source, quotation method (bid, mid etc.) and any applicable quotation amount.

cashCollateralValuationMethod.description: Specifies the parameters representing several mid-market valuation and replacement value methods.

minimumQuotationAmount.description: In the determination of a cash settlement amount, if weighted average quotations are to be obtained, the minimum quotation amount specifies a minimum intended threshold amount of outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount of the lower of either USD 1,000,000 (or its equivalent in the relevant obligation currency) or the quotation amount. ISDA 2003 Term: Minimum Quotation Amount.

quotationAmount.description: In the determination of a cash settlement amount, if weighted average quotations are to be obtained, the quotation amount specifies an upper limit to the outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount equal to the floating rate payer calculation amount. ISDA 2003 Term: Quotation Amount.

quotationMethod.description: The type of price quotations to be requested from dealers when determining the market value of the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement, or which rate quote is to be observed for a fixing. For example, Bid, Offer, Mid-market or Exercising Party Pays. ISDA 2003 Term: Quotation Method. The meaning of Exercising Party Pays is defined in the 2000 ISDA Definitions, Section 17.2. Certain Definitions Relating to Cash Settlement, paragraph (j).

valuationMethod.description: The ISDA defined methodology for determining the final price of the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement. (ISDA 2003 Term: Valuation Method). For example, Market, Highest etc.

valuationSource.description: The source for obtaining a valuation. This may come from some information source (e.g. Reuters), from a rate option fixing (e.g. FX fixing for cross-currency settlement), or from a set of reference banks. This is a mandatory attribute as the valuation method relies on one of those sources to be specified.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/ValuationMethodEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify the ISDA defined methodology for determining the final price of the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/ValuationPostponement
content.description: Specifies how long to wait to get a quote from a settlement rate option upon a price source disruption.

maximumDaysOfPostponement.description: The maximum number of days to wait for a quote from the disrupted settlement rate option before proceeding to the next method.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/ValuationSource
content.description: A class describing the method for obtaining a settlement rate, specified through either an information source (page), a settlement rate option (fixing) or by using quotes from reference banks.

dealerOrCCP.description: Holds an identifier for the reference entity that is agreed by both parties as a basis for cash settlement calculations. This could be a dealer from whom quotations are obtained by the calculation agent on the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement in a credit event. ISDA 2003 Term: Dealer. This could be the clearing organization (CCP, DCO) to which the trade should be cleared, as applicable for cash-settled swaptions.

informationSource.description: The information source where a published or displayed market rate will be obtained, e.g. Telerate Page 3750.

quotedCurrencyPair.description: Defines the two currencies for an FX trade and the quotation relationship between the two currencies.  This attribute was formerly part of 'fxSettlementTerms', which is now being harmonised into a common 'CashSettlementTerms' that includes a 'ValuationDate'.

referenceBanks.description: A container for a set of reference institutions that may be called upon to provide rate quotations as part of the method to determine the applicable cash settlement amount. If institutions are not specified, it is assumed that reference institutions will be agreed between the parties on the exercise date, or in the case of swap transaction to which mandatory early termination is applicable, the cash settlement valuation date.

settlementRateOption.description: The rate option to use for the fixing. Currently only applicable to foreign exchange fixing in case of cross-currency settlement.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/calculatedrate/CalculatedRateDetails
content.description: Type for reporting details of calculated rates, including the observations that went into the final reported rate.

aggregateValue.description: The total sum or product of all the individual terms that went into the calculated rate.

aggregateWeight.description: The total weight of all the terms that went into the calculated rate.

compoundedGrowth.description: The compounding curve, showing how the initial value grew during the calculation period.

growthFactor.description: The daily growth factors, showing the weighted rates divided by the day count basis plus one, giving how much the value grows for each step in the calculation.

observations.description: The observation dates and weights for each observation date.

weightedRates.description: The weighted value of each observation.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/calculatedrate/CalculatedRateObservationDatesAndWeights
content.description: Type for reporting the observations dates and the corresponding weights going into a daily calculated rate

observationDates.description: The observation date upon which the rate is observed.

weights.description: The corresponding weight for each date.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/calculatedrate/CalculatedRateObservations
content.description: Type for reporting observations that went into the final reported rate.

observationDates.description: The observation date upon which the rate is observed.

observedRates.description: The value observed for that date

processedRates.description: The value after any processing, such as application of caps or floors.

weights.description: The corresponding weight for each date.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/calculatedrate/CalculationMethodEnum
content.description: What calculation type is required, averaging or compounding. This enumeration is used to represent the definitions of modular calculated rates as described in the 2021 ISDA Definitions, section 7.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/calculatedrate/CalculationShiftMethodEnum
content.description: the specific calculation method, e.g. lookback. This enumeration is used to represent the definitions of modular calculated rates as described in the 2021 ISDA Definitions, section 7.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/calculatedrate/FallbackRateParameters
content.description: Defines the structure needed to represent fallback rate parameters. This type is used to represent modular computed rates in interestRatePayouts.

calculationParameters.description: Support for modular calculated rates, such such as lockout compound calculations.

effectiveDate.description: The date the fallback rate takes effect.

floatingRateIndex.description: The floating rate index that is used as the basis of the fallback rate.

spreadAdjustment.description: The economic spread applied to the underlying fallback rate to replicate the original risky rate.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/calculatedrate/FloatingRateCalculationParameters
content.description: Defines the structures needed to represent the calculation parameters for daily averaged and compounded modular rates as defined in the 2021 ISDA Definitions in Section 7. This type is used to represent modular computed rates in interestRatePayouts.

applicableBusinessDays.description: the business days that are applicable for the calculation.

observationParameters.description: any applicable observation parameters, such as daily caps or floors.

observationShiftCalculation.description: any obervation shift parameters if applicable.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/calculatedrate/InflationCalculationMethodEnum
content.description: Indicates how to use the inflation index to calculate the payment (e.g. Ratio, Return, Spread). Added for Inflation Asset Swap

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/calculatedrate/InflationCalculationStyleEnum
content.description: Indicates the style of how the inflation index calculates the payment (e.g. YearOnYear, ZeroCoupon).

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/calculatedrate/ObservationParameters
content.description: Parameters on daily observed computed rates, specifically daily caps and floors. This type is used to represent modular computed rates in interestRatePayouts.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/calculatedrate/ObservationPeriodDatesEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify whether rate calculations occur relative to the first or last day of a calculation period. Done in uppercase due to a bug in code generation. This enumeration is used to represent the definitions of modular calculated rates as described in the 2021 ISDA Definitions, section 7.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/calculatedrate/ObservationShiftCalculation
content.description: Parameters to describe the observation shift for a daily compounded or averaged floating rate. This type is used to represent modular computed rates in interestRatePayouts.

additionalBusinessDays.description: Any additional business days that be applicable.

calculationBase.description: Whether the rate is calculated in advance, in arrears, or relative to a reset date.

offsetDays.description: The number of days of observation shift.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/calculatedrate/OffsetCalculation
content.description: Defines business day shifts for daily componded or averaged rates.  This type is used for lookback and lockout rates. This type is used to represent modular computed rates in interestRatePayouts.

offsetDays.description: The number of business days offset.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/fro/FloatingRateIndexCalculationDefaults
content.description: This holds the rate calculation defaults applicable for a floating rate index.

category.description: The ISDA FRO category (e.g. screen rate or calculated rate).

indexStyle.description: The ISDA FRO style (e.g. term rate, swap rate, etc).

method.description: The ISDA FRO calculation method (e.g. OIS Compounding).

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/fro/FloatingRateIndexCalculationMethodEnum
content.description: 3rd level ISDA FRO category.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/fro/FloatingRateIndexCategoryEnum
content.description: Top level ISDA FRO category.

fro.description: The underlying FRO name and designated maturity.

currency.description: FRO currency - 3 character ISO currrency code

floatingRateIndex.description: The reference index that is used to specify the floating interest rate. The FpML standard maintains the list of such indices, which are positioned as enumeration values as part of the CDM.

content.name: cdm/observable/asset/fro/FloatingRateIndexStyleEnum
content.description: Second level ISDA FRO category.

content.name: cdm/observable/common/DeterminationMethodEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify the method according to which an amount or a date is determined.

content.name: cdm/observable/common/TimeTypeEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify points in the day when option exercise and valuation can occur.

businessCenter.description: Inclusion of this business center element implies that Greenwich Mean Time in Section 3.3 of the 2003 ISDA Credit Derivatives Definitions is replaced by the local time of the city indicated by the businessCenter element value.

notifyingParty.description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring. ISDA 2003 Term: Notifying Party.

publiclyAvailableInformation.description: A specified condition to settlement. Publicly available information means information that reasonably confirms any of the facts relevant to determining that a credit event or potential repudiation/moratorium, as applicable, has occurred. The ISDA defined list (2003) is the market standard and is considered comprehensive, and a minimum of two differing public sources must have published the relevant information, to declare a Credit Event. ISDA 2003 Term: Notice of Publicly Available Information Applicable.

content.name: cdm/observable/event/CreditEvents
content.description: A class to specify the applicable Credit Events that would trigger a settlement, as specified in the related Confirmation and defined in the ISDA 2014 Credit Definition article IV section 4.1.

bankruptcy.description: A credit event. The reference entity has been dissolved or has become insolvent. It also covers events that may be a precursor to insolvency such as instigation of bankruptcy or insolvency proceedings. Sovereign trades are not subject to Bankruptcy as 'technically' a Sovereign cannot become bankrupt. ISDA 2003 Term: Bankruptcy.

creditEventNotice.description: A specified condition to settlement. An irrevocable written or verbal notice that describes a credit event that has occurred. The notice is sent from the notifying party (either the buyer or the seller) to the counterparty. It provides information relevant to determining that a credit event has occurred. This is typically accompanied by Publicly Available Information. ISDA 2003 Term: Credit Event Notice.

defaultRequirement.description: In relation to certain credit events, serves as a threshold for Obligation Acceleration, Obligation Default, Repudiation/Moratorium and Restructuring. Market standard is USD 10,000,000 (JPY 1,000,000,000 for all Japanese Yen trades). This is applied on an aggregate or total basis across all Obligations of the Reference Entity. Used to prevent technical/operational errors from triggering credit events. ISDA 2003 Term: Default Requirement.

distressedRatingsDowngrade.description: A credit event. Results from the fact that the rating of the reference obligation is down-graded to a distressed rating level. From a usage standpoint, this credit event is typically not applicable in case of RMBS trades.

failureToPay.description: A credit event. This credit event triggers, after the expiration of any applicable grace period, if the reference entity fails to make due payments in an aggregate amount of not less than the payment requirement on one or more obligations (e.g. a missed coupon payment). ISDA 2003 Term: Failure to Pay.

failureToPayInterest.description: A credit event. Corresponds to the failure by the Reference Entity to pay an expected interest amount or the payment of an actual interest amount that is less than the expected interest amount. ISDA 2003 Term: Failure to Pay Interest.

failureToPayPrincipal.description: A credit event. Corresponds to the failure by the Reference Entity to pay an expected principal amount or the payment of an actual principal amount that is less than the expected principal amount. ISDA 2003 Term: Failure to Pay Principal.

governmentalIntervention.description: A credit event. A governmental intervention is an event resulting from an action by a governmental authority that materially impacts the reference entity's obligations, such as an interest rate reduction, principal reduction, deferral of interest or principal, change in priority ranking, or change in currency or composition of payment. ISDA 2014 Term: Governmental Intervention.

impliedWritedown.description: A credit event. Results from the fact that losses occur to the underlying instruments that do not result in reductions of the outstanding principal of the reference obligation.

maturityExtension.description: A credit event. Results from the fact that the underlier fails to make principal payments as expected.

obligationAcceleration.description: A credit event. One or more of the obligations have been declared due and payable before they would otherwise have been due and payable as a result of, or on the basis of, the occurrence of a default, event of default or other similar condition or event other than failure to pay (preferred by the market over Obligation Default, because more definitive and encompasses the definition of Obligation Default - this is more favorable to the Seller). Subject to the default requirement amount. ISDA 2003 Term: Obligation Acceleration.

obligationDefault.description: A credit event. One or more of the obligations have become capable of being declared due and payable before they would otherwise have been due and payable as a result of, or on the basis of, the occurrence of a default, event of default or other similar condition or event other than failure to pay. ISDA 2003 Term: Obligation Default.

repudiationMoratorium.description: A credit event. The reference entity, or a governmental authority, either refuses to recognise or challenges the validity of one or more obligations of the reference entity, or imposes a moratorium thereby postponing payments on one or more of the obligations of the reference entity. Subject to the default requirement amount. ISDA 2003 Term: Repudiation/Moratorium.

restructuring.description: A credit event. A restructuring is an event that materially impacts the reference entity's obligations, such as an interest rate reduction, principal reduction, deferral of interest or principal, change in priority ranking, or change in currency or composition of payment. ISDA 2003 Term: Restructuring.

writedown.description: A credit event. Results from the fact that the underlier writes down its outstanding principal amount.

content.name: cdm/observable/event/DeterminationMethodology
content.description: Specifies the method according to which an amount or a date is determined.

averagingMethod.description: Specifies enumerations for the type of averaging calculation.

determinationMethod.description: Represents a more granular dimention of observation. Typically relevent for resolving a unique equity price, which can be expressed as trade-weighted or volume-weighted averages.

applicable.description: Indicates whether the failure to pay provision is applicable.

gracePeriodExtension.description: If this element is specified, indicates whether or not a grace period extension is applicable. ISDA 2003 Term: Grace Period Extension Applicable.

paymentRequirement.description: Specifies a threshold for the failure to pay credit event. Market standard is USD 1,000,000 (JPY 100,000,000 for Japanese Yen trades) or its equivalent in the relevant obligation currency. This is applied on an aggregate basis across all Obligations of the Reference Entity. Intended to prevent technical/operational errors from triggering credit events. ISDA 2003 Term: Payment Requirement

content.name: cdm/observable/event/FeaturePayment
content.description: Payment made following trigger occurrence.

amount.description: The monetary quantity in currency units.

currency.description: The currency in which an amount is denominated.

payerReceiver.description: This attribute doesn't exist as part of the FpML construct, which makes use of the PayerReceiver.model group.

applicable.description: Indicates whether the grace period extension provision is applicable.

gracePeriod.description: The number of calendar or business days after any due date that the reference entity has to fulfil its obligations before a failure to pay credit event is deemed to have occurred. ISDA 2003 Term: Grace Period.

content.name: cdm/observable/event/IndexEventConsequenceEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify the consequences of Index Events.

content.name: cdm/observable/event/MarketDisruptionEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify the handling of an averaging date market disruption for an equity derivative transaction.

content.name: cdm/observable/event/Observation
content.description: Defines a single, numerical value that was observed in the marketplace. Observations of market data are made independently to business events or trade life-cycle events, so data instances of Observation can be created independently of any other model type, hence it is annotated as a root type. Observations will be broadly reused in many situations, so references to Observation are supported via the 'key' annotation.

observationIdentifier.description: Represents the observation was made i.e. how to uniquely identify the observed value among the population of all available market data.

observedValue.description: Specifies the observed value as a number.

content.name: cdm/observable/event/ObservationIdentifier
content.description: Defines the parameters needed to uniquely identify a piece of data among the population of all available market data.

determinationMethodology.description: Specifies the method according to which an amount or a date is determined.

informationSource.description: Represents where the market data published and should be observed.

observable.description: Represents the asset or rate to which the observation relates.

observationDate.description: Specifies the date value to use when resolving the market data.

publicSource.description: A public information source, e.g. a particular newspaper or electronic news service, that may publish relevant information used in the determination of whether or not a credit event has occurred. ISDA 2003 Term: Public Source.

specifiedNumber.description: The minimum number of the specified public information sources that must publish information that reasonably confirms that a credit event has occurred. The market convention is two. ISDA 2003 Term: Specified Number.

standardPublicSources.description: If this element is specified and set to 'true', indicates that ISDA defined Standard Public Sources are applicable.

applicable.description: Indicates whether the restructuring provision is applicable.

multipleCreditEventNotices.description: Presence of this element and value set to 'true' indicates that Section 3.9 of the 2003 Credit Derivatives Definitions shall apply. Absence of this element indicates that Section 3.9 shall not apply. NOTE: Not allowed under ISDA Credit 1999.

multipleHolderObligation.description: In relation to a restructuring credit event, unless multiple holder obligation is not specified restructurings are limited to multiple holder obligations. A multiple holder obligation means an obligation that is held by more than three holders that are not affiliates of each other and where at least two thirds of the holders must agree to the event that constitutes the restructuring credit event. ISDA 2003 Term: Multiple Holder Obligation.

restructuringType.description: Specifies the type of restructuring that is applicable.

content.name: cdm/observable/event/RestructuringEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify the form of the restructuring credit event that is applicable to the credit default swap.

content.name: cdm/observable/event/ShareExtraordinaryEventEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify the consequences of extraordinary events relating to the underlying.

content.name: cdm/observable/event/Trigger
content.description: Trigger point at which feature is effective.

triggerTimeType.description: The valuation time type of knock condition.

content.name: cdm/observable/event/TriggerEvent
content.description: Observation point for trigger.

featurePayment.description: The feature payment, i.e. the payment made following trigger occurrence.

content.name: cdm/observable/event/TriggerTimeTypeEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify the time of day which would be considered for valuing the knock event.

content.name: cdm/observable/event/TriggerTypeEnum
content.description: The enumerated values to specify whether an option will trigger or expire depending upon whether the spot rate is above or below the barrier rate.

content.name: cdm/product/asset/AdditionalFixedPayments
content.description: A class to specify the events that will give rise to the payment additional fixed payments.

interestShortfallReimbursement.description: An additional Fixed Payment Event. Corresponds to the payment by or on behalf of the Issuer of an actual interest amount in respect to the reference obligation that is greater than the expected interest amount. ISDA 2003 Term: Interest Shortfall Reimbursement.

principalShortfallReimbursement.description: An additional Fixed Payment Event. Corresponds to the payment by or on behalf of the Issuer of an actual principal amount in respect to the reference obligation that is greater than the expected principal amount. ISDA 2003 Term: Principal Shortfall Reimbursement.

writedownReimbursement.description: An Additional Fixed Payment. Corresponds to the payment by or on behalf of the issuer of an amount in respect to the reference obligation in reduction of the prior writedowns. ISDA 2003 Term: Writedown Reimbursement.

content.name: cdm/product/asset/AssetDeliveryInformation
content.description: Contains the information relative to the delivery of the asset.

deliveryCapacity.description: The number of units included in the transaction for each delivery interval

location.description: Defines the location of the delivery of the commodity.

periods.description: Defines the periods of delivery, including the delivery profile.

content.name: cdm/product/asset/AssetDeliveryPeriods
content.description: Defines the periods of delivery, including the delivery profile.

profile.description: Defines the delivery profile of the asset, including the load type and the delivery intervals.

content.name: cdm/product/asset/AssetDeliveryProfile
content.description: Defines the delivery profile of the asset, including the load type and the delivery intervals.

bankHolidaysTreatment.description: Specifies whether the dates defined include holidays or not.

block.description: Defines a delivery profile block, including start and end time, days of the week, duration, delivery capacity and price time interval quantity.

content.name: cdm/product/asset/AssetDeliveryProfileBlock
content.description: Defines a delivery profile block, including start and end time, days of the week, duration, delivery capacity and price time interval quantity.

dayOfWeek.description: The days of the week of the delivery.

deliveryCapacity.description: The number of units included in the transaction for each delivery interval

endTime.description: The end time of the delivery interval for each block or shape.

priceTimeIntervalQuantity.description: Price per quantity per delivery time interval.

startTime.description: The start time of the delivery interval for each block or shape.

content.name: cdm/product/asset/BankHolidayTreatmentEnum
content.description: Defines whether the bank holidays are treated as weekdays or weekends in terms of delivery profile in the context of commodity products, in particular those with peak or off-peak delivery profiles.

content.name: cdm/product/asset/BasketReferenceInformation
content.description: CDS Basket Reference Information.

basketName.description: The name of the basket expressed as a free format string. FpML does not define usage rules for this element.

mthToDefault.description: M th reference obligation to default to allow representation of N th to M th defaults.
